drawio_review_note: Aligned with TrialBench arXiv:2407.00631, Sections 2-4 and Appendix; official TrialBench project. TrialBench integrates ClinicalTrials.gov XML records with DrugBank, TrialTrove, ICD-10, and CCS resources. Trial interventions are linked to drug SMILES and molecular graphs, conditions to hierarchical disease codes, and outcomes to NCT identifiers. Task builders retain only information available before the target event, remove constant or all-null features, apply task-specific eligibility filters, and derive labels from dates, counts, events, TrialTrove records, or GPT-assisted extraction where documented. This produces 23 AI-ready datasets spanning eight clinical-trial prediction tasks and five modalities. Standard multimodal encoders feed task heads, and evaluation uses classification, regression, ranking, or generation metrics appropriate to each dataset.
